title: Destroy Ganon
desc: Defeat Calamity Ganon and save Princess Zelda. The ultimate quest awaits at Hyrule Castle.

title: Seek Out Impa
desc: Find Impa in Kakariko Village to learn about the four Divine Beasts and the path ahead.

title: Free the Divine Beasts
desc: Liberate the four Divine Beasts from Ganon's control. Each beast holds a champion's spirit.

title: Divine Beast Vah Ruta
desc: The water-controlling elephant in Zora's Domain. Master Sidon will guide you.

title: Divine Beast Vah Rudania
desc: The fire-breathing salamander on Death Mountain. The Gorons need your help.

title: Divine Beast Vah Medoh
desc: The wind-manipulating eagle above Rito Village. Reclaim the skies.

title: Divine Beast Vah Naboris
desc: The thunder-wielding camel in Gerudo Desert. The sandstorm conceals its path.

title: The Hero's Sword
desc: Pull the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Korok Forest. Prove your worth.

title: Locked Mementos
desc: Recover Zelda's research notes scattered across Hyrule. Piece together her story.

title: A Gift from the Monks
desc: Complete all 120 Shrines and claim the ancient reward from the Forgotten Temple.

title: The Cursed Statue
desc: Visit the Spring of Power, Wisdom, and Courage to lift the curse upon a mysterious statue.

title: Stalhorse: Pictured!
desc: Photograph a Stalhorse for the Stable owner near the river. Only appears at night.

title: The Spring of Power
desc: Offer a Dinraal's scale at the Spring of Power in Eldin to unlock a Shrine.

title: Captured Memories
desc: Recover Zelda's lost memories from locations across Hyrule. Each photo holds a piece of the past.

title: Subdued Ceremony
desc: Remember the ceremony where Link was appointed as Zelda's knight. At the Temple of Time.

title: Desperate Refuge
desc: Recall Zelda's desperate attempt to seal Ganon at Hyrule Castle. The final stand.

title: Silent Princess
desc: Remember the quiet moment when Zelda noticed the Silent Princess flower. At Sanidin Park.

title: Blades of the Yiga
desc: Recall the Yiga Clan's ambush and Zelda's awakening of power. On Blatchery Plain.

title: Shelter from the Storm
desc: Remember taking shelter from the rain with Zelda. Near Lanayru Promenade.

title: Return of the Calamity
desc: The final memory of Calamity Ganon's return 100 years ago. At Hyrule Castle.
